name: Unfinished Business
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
What? Really? You want to know more? But you've already done so much for me, adventurer. I couldn't possibly ask you to enter Hearthglen itself on my behalf.

Are you sure, adventurer? Hearthglen is much more dangerous than the Pass--I cannot provide you any protection  or even information about what you might face.

Well, if you really are willing to help, then enter the town and find a high place to gain a good view of the town. From there you can gauge their numbers and report them back to me. But be careful....
narrative.objectives: Enter Hearthglen and find a high vantage point from which you can see the town and gauge the Scarlet Crusade's forces, then return to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You've done it, adventurer! Thank you!

I'll return to Elling... I mean Stormwind as soon as I can. Here, take this coin, it's the least I can do for you. You're a credit to your people, adventurer. Thank you and good luck.
narrative.requestItemsText: It's a dangerous task, adventurer. I envy your courage.
narrative.endText: Overlook Hearthglen from a high vantage point
